initialExam.title: EPFO Stenographer 2026
initialExam.description: EPFO Stenographer recruitment for stenography and secretarial work in EPFO headquarters and regional offices across India.
initialExam.eligibility: 12th pass with stenography skills (80 wpm English / 60 wpm Hindi)
initialExam.syllabus: General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Awareness, English Language, Quantitative Aptitude.
initialExam.examPattern: Written Test: 200 questions, 200 marks, 2 hours. Skill Test: Stenography (dictation + transcription).
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Test → Stenography Skill Test → Document Verification → Final Merit
initialExam.careerGrowth: Stenographer → Senior Stenographer → Personal Assistant → Private Secretary.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit epfindia.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, Medical, Pension, LTC
